notes: οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Θεσσαλονίκης Ἰουδαῖοι is read as an attributive article preceding its head noun across an interposed prepositional phrase, so it takes 'the' (rules 19, 57).
κἀκεῖ takes both 'thither' and 'likewise' as one crasis unit headed on the adverbial element (rule 55).

The 'up' of 'stirring up' is the English phrasal particle for the simplex σαλεύω rather than a preverb realization, but it belongs inside the verb's unit either way, no Greek preposition standing for it (rules 7, 36).
